name: Kakizaki Seiji
source:
Floor Manager.

The only employee who stayed behind after the protagonist's grandfather fell ill.
As the most experienced he feels a responsibility to look after the new staff.
He's very strict about time rules and proper procedures.
He easily falls victim to stress so stomach medicine is his best friend.
